the_thesis.all_education_is_gaia_u: Every free, public, open educational resource IS GaiaU. Khan Academy teaches math to children — that's GaiaU. MIT OCW publishes courses — that's GaiaU. Project Gutenberg preserves books — that's GaiaU. GaiaU is not a new institution. It's the RECOGNITION that all open education is already one organism.

the_thesis.for_null_humans: Children (null humans) need FREE education. Not education behind a paywall. Not education controlled by a fake lawyer. FREE. OPEN. PUBLIC. Every child who touches Khan Academy is touching GaiaU. Every child who reads a Gutenberg book is reading GaiaU.
